title: The Miraculousness And Testimony Of The Quran 17th Degree Sacred Distinctions And Its Testimony To Divine Unity

questions.question: What is the main message of this passage about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It teaches that the Qur’an gives strong proof for Allah’s existence, oneness, qualities, and beautiful Names.

questions.question: Which parts of the Qur’an are described as supporting one another in this testimony?
questions.answer: Its chapters, verses, lights, mysteries, fruits, and effects all support the same truth together.

questions.question: According to the passage, what kind of proof does the Qur’an give?
questions.answer: It gives evidence that works like clear arguments and proofs.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah’s existence?
questions.answer: It presents Allah as the One whose existence is necessary, meaning His existence is not dependent on anything else.

questions.question: Besides Allah’s existence and oneness, what else does the Qur’an testify to?
questions.answer: It also points to His attributes and His Names.

questions.question: What does the agreement of the Qur’an’s verses show?
questions.answer: It shows that the message is united and consistent, not confused or contradictory.

questions.question: What can be understood from the mention of the Qur’an’s “fruits and works”?
questions.answer: It means the Qur’an’s results in people’s lives and in the world also support its truth.

questions.question: How does the passage connect the Qur’an’s testimony to the faith of believers?
questions.answer: It says the believers’ endless testimony comes out of the Qur’an’s testimony.

questions.question: What idea about unity is repeated throughout the passage?
questions.answer: The passage keeps stressing that all parts of the Qur’an point to one God alone.

questions.question: If all the parts named in the passage agree, what does that suggest about the Qur’an’s message?
questions.answer: It suggests that its message is deeply reliable and fully joined together.

questions.question: In a short phrase, how does the passage present the Qur’an’s role in belief?
questions.answer: It presents the Qur’an as a powerful witness that leads people to faith in Allah.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the Qur’an testify about Allah?
questions.answer: It testifies to His existence, His oneness, His attributes, and His Names.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the way the Qur’an gives this testimony?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an gives it through many evidences that act like proofs.

questions.question: What does the harmony among the Qur’an’s chapters teach us?
questions.answer: It teaches that the Qur’an carries one united message throughout.

questions.question: Why does the passage list several kinds of agreement inside the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It does this to show that many different features of the Qur’an all point to the same truth.

questions.question: What can a reader infer from the fact that so many parts agree with each other?
questions.answer: A reader can infer that the Qur’an’s testimony is strong and trustworthy.

questions.question: How are believers connected to this testimony?
questions.answer: Their witness to faith comes from the witness already given by the Qur’an.

questions.question: Does the passage present belief as based on blind following or on evidence? Explain.
questions.answer: It presents belief as based on evidence, because it speaks again and again about proofs and supporting signs.

questions.question: What does this passage teach about the source of true belief?
questions.answer: It teaches that true belief grows from the Qur’an’s clear testimony.

questions.question: What is one strong summary sentence for the whole passage?
questions.answer: The whole passage says that the Qur’an, in all its parts, powerfully proves the truth of belief in Allah.

questions.question: What central truth does the Qur’an confirm in this passage?
questions.answer: It confirms that there is one Allah whose existence is certain and necessary.

questions.question: What four things about Allah are named in the passage?
questions.answer: His existence, His unity, His attributes, and His Names.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the relationship between the Qur’an’s chapters and verses?
questions.answer: It describes them as being in agreement with one another.

questions.question: Why is agreement inside a text important for understanding it?
questions.answer: It shows consistency and helps prove that the message is dependable.

questions.question: How do the Qur’an’s outcomes in life help its testimony?
questions.answer: The good results that come from it support the truth of what it teaches.

questions.question: What does the passage say is the source of the believers’ continuing witness?
questions.answer: It says their witness comes from the Qur’an’s own witness.

questions.question: Why might the passage mention many forms of support instead of only one?
questions.answer: To show that the proof is rich, layered, and strong from every side.

questions.question: If someone asked whether the passage focuses more on emotion or on reason, what would be the best answer?
questions.answer: It focuses more on reasoned faith, because it keeps pointing to evidence, harmony, and proof.

questions.question: What lesson should a student take from this passage about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: A student should understand that the Qur’an is presented as a complete and united proof leading people to know Allah.

questions.question: In this passage, what job does the Qur’an have?
questions.answer: It serves as a witness and proof for belief in Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Qur’an being miraculous?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an is miraculous in every way mentioned here.

questions.question: Which inner signs of the Qur’an are named as agreeing with one another?
questions.answer: Its chapters, verses, lights, mysteries, fruits, and works are named.

questions.question: How does this inner agreement strengthen the message?
questions.answer: It shows that the Qur’an’s message is unified and supports itself from many sides.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: It teaches that the Qur’an clearly points to Allah as the only true God.

questions.question: Why does the passage call the Qur’an’s evidences “proofs”?
questions.answer: Because they are presented as strong reasons to believe, not weak claims.

questions.question: What comes from the Qur’an’s testimony, according to the passage?
questions.answer: The believers’ countless witness of faith comes from it.

questions.question: What does this suggest about the Qur’an’s influence on believers?
questions.answer: It suggests that the Qur’an shapes and supports their faith deeply.

questions.question: What is the best brief summary of the passage?
questions.answer: The passage says the Qur’an’s fully united message proves Allah and inspires the faith of believers.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Qur’an testifies to?
questions.answer: It testifies to one necessary and unique God, along with His qualities and Names.

questions.question: What does “in every respect” tell us about the Qur’an in this passage?
questions.answer: It tells us that its miraculous nature is complete and not limited to just one side.

questions.question: What is the role of the Qur’an’s chapters in this testimony?
questions.answer: Their shared agreement helps confirm the truth the Qur’an teaches.

questions.question: What is the role of the Qur’an’s verses in this testimony?
questions.answer: Their harmony with one another adds more support to the same message.

questions.question: Why is it important that the passage mentions both inner features and outer results?
questions.answer: It shows that the Qur’an is supported both by what it contains and by what it brings about.

questions.question: What does the phrase about believers’ testimony “issuing forth” mean here?
questions.answer: It means their witness flows out from the Qur’an as its result.

questions.question: What can we learn about the foundation of iman from this passage?
questions.answer: We learn that iman stands on the Qur’an’s truth and proofs.

questions.question: How does the structure of the passage help its meaning?
questions.answer: It builds strength by listing many united signs that all point to the same conclusion.

questions.question: If a classmate said this passage is only about the Qur’an itself, what important point would they be missing?
questions.answer: They would be missing that the passage says the Qur’an leads beyond itself to knowledge of Allah.

questions.question: What final conclusion does the passage push the reader toward?
questions.answer: It pushes the reader to accept that the Qur’an is a clear proof of Allah’s reality and oneness.

questions.question: What is the biggest claim made in this passage?
questions.answer: The biggest claim is that the Qur’an strongly proves the truth about Allah.

questions.question: What truths about Allah are included in that claim?
questions.answer: They include that He exists, that He is one, and that He has perfect attributes and Names.

questions.question: How does the passage show that the Qur’an is not divided in its message?
questions.answer: It says its different parts and signs all agree with each other.

questions.question: Name two groups of things inside the Qur’an that are said to be in harmony.
questions.answer: Its chapters and verses are one pair, and its lights and mysteries are another pair.

questions.question: Why does the passage emphasize many kinds of agreement?
questions.answer: It emphasizes them to show that the proof is broad and reinforced from many directions.

questions.question: What kind of relationship between the Qur’an and the believers does the passage describe?
questions.answer: It describes the believers’ testimony as growing out of the Qur’an’s testimony.

questions.question: How does the passage mix belief and evidence?
questions.answer: It presents belief as something supported by clear signs and proofs.

questions.question: Give a one-sentence summary of the whole passage.
questions.answer: The passage teaches that the Qur’an, through all its united parts and effects, is a powerful witness to Allah’s existence and oneness.
